text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out with Curren 
Bouquetd'or—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Curren Bouquetd'or pointed, 
I saw a crane game filled with plushies 
inspired by Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list:
Staring like that... is there something 
you want?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Uh, ah—well... I was just wondering... 
what kind of flowers would make a 
beautiful harmony with those girls—
choice_data_list: そんなに見つめて、欲しいものでもあるの？
choice_data_list_en: Staring at me like that, is there something you want?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I just thought—that there's a flower that 
suits each and every one of them, you 
see...
choice_data_list:
Then, shall we grab a few and try them 
out?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: なら、いくつか取って試してみようか
choice_data_list_en: Then, shall we take a few and try them out?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: 俺も花と合わせたとこ、見てみたいから
私も花と合わせたとこ、見てみたいから
choice_data_list_en: Because I want to see how it looks paired with flowers too.
Because I want to see how it looks with the flowers too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I will properly cheer— 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
